content.text:
I worked this out by hand because no code tool was available. I could not save `diagram.png`, so the image path and sha256 are null. Energies are relative to the lowest level and come from the full strong-field Tanabe–Sugano matrices with C/B = 3390/828 = 4.094.

**Method**
- **Matrices:** I set up the full matrix for each symmetry: ⁴A₂g, ⁴T₂g, ⁴T₁g (2×2), ²E_g (4×4), ²T₁g (5×5), ²T₂g (5×5), and ²A₁g and ²A₂g (single states).
- **Checks at Dq = 0:**
  - The ²E_g and ²T₂g matrices give back the free-ion terms ²G, ²H and ²D exactly. I had to correct one sign I recalled in ²T₂g (the coupling between t₂²(³T₁)e and t₂e²(¹E) is −3√3 B).
  - The ²T₁g matrix was partly rebuilt from its Dq = 0 terms. That pins it down at Dq = 0 but does not fully confirm how its states mix as Dq grows, so its values carry more uncertainty than the others.
- **Solving:** I found the lowest root of each larger block by iterative partitioning. Values should be good to about ±0.02 B.
- **Checking the sixth level:** where a level was close to the sixth slot, I counted eigenvalues below a test energy to confirm which level comes sixth. This showed the second ²T₁g level never enters the six.

**Two judgement calls**
- **Dq = 0:** the lowest three levels (⁴A₂g, ⁴T₂g, ⁴T₁g from ⁴F) are all at 0, and the four ²G components are all at 16.28. I listed ²E_g and ²T₁g as the fifth and sixth levels because they are the lowest ²G components once Dq > 0.
- **Dq/B = 0.5:** the sixth level is ²A₁g at 21.28, only just below ⁴T₁g(P) at 21.32.

**Results (E/B above the ground level)**

| Dq/B | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ⁴T₂g 0 | ⁴T₁g(F) 0 | ⁴T₁g(P) 15.00 | ²E_g 16.28 | ²T₁g 16.28 |
| 0.5 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ⁴T₂g 5.00 | ⁴T₁g(F) 8.68 | ²E_g 18.43 | ²T₁g 19.14 | ²A₁g 21.28 |
| 1.0 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ⁴T₂g 10.00 | ⁴T₁g(F) 16.48 | ²E_g 18.95 | ²T₁g 19.88 | ²T₂g 25.89 |
| 1.5 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ⁴T₂g 15.00 | ²E_g 19.25 | ²T₁g 20.21 | ⁴T₁g(F) 23.29 | ²T₂g 27.59 |
| 2.0 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ²E_g 19.47 | ⁴T₂g 20.00 | ²T₁g 20.41 | ²T₂g 28.84 | ⁴T₁g(F) 29.36 |
| 2.5 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ²E_g 19.64 | ²T₁g 20.55 | ⁴T₂g 25.00 | ²T₂g 29.77 | ⁴T₁g(F) 35.00 |
| 3.0 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ²E_g 19.78 | ²T₁g 20.65 | ⁴T₂g 30.00 | ²T₂g 30.49 | ⁴T₁g(F) 40.41 |
| 3.5 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ²E_g 19.90 | ²T₁g 20.72 | ²T₂g 31.06 | ⁴T₂g 35.00 | ⁴T₁g(F) 45.68 |
| 4.0 | ⁴A₂g 0 | ²E_g 20.00 | ²T₁g 20.78 | ²T₂g 31.52 | ⁴T₂g 40.00 | ⁴T₁g(F) 50.88 |

The ground level is ⁴A₂g at every point.
